---
title: Liver pâté
id: MAR-0056
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 50
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 150 g of veal liver
- 150 g of chicken livers
- 150 g of butter
- 15 g of white truffle
- 2 sage leaves
- 1 rosemary sprig
- 1 tablespoon of Marsala wine
- 1 tablespoon of rum
- 1 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Clean the chicken livers and the liver, wash them several times and cut them into small pieces.
2. Heat the oil and 20 g of butter in a non-stick pan, in which you will add the liver pieces with the sage and rosemary.
3. Let it flavor for a few minutes over low heat, pour in the Marsala and let it evaporate.
4. Season with salt and pepper, then turn off the heat.
5. Pass the preparation through a sieve, collecting it in a bowl.
6. Work the butter at room temperature and add it to the preparation.
7. Mix the ingredients, stirring with a wooden spoon, moisten with the rum and continue to stir.
8. Finally add the truffle cut into slivers, then mix, level the surface and cover the bowl.
9. Let it rest in the refrigerator until the pâté has hardened.
